newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-FRANCE V SPAIN WILL INAUGURATE NEW STADIUM.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FRANCE V SPAIN WILL INAUGURATE NEW STADIUM.

text.p: France will inaugurate the new national stadium being built for the 1998 World Cup finals with a friendly against Spain next January, six months before the tournament begins.

French Football Federation president Claude Simonet, who made the announcement on Friday, said the likely date of the friendly at the Stade de France in the northern Parisian suburb of Saint-Denis is January 28, 1998.
European champions Germany turned down France's invitation, while Spain confirmed their availability before Olympic champions Nigeria and twice World Cup winners Argentina.
World Cup holders Brazil, and former winners England and Italy, were not considered as they are taking part with the hosts in the warm-up Tournament of France this June.
